title: Consultor de inovação ii
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Consultor de inovação ii em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a vaga: O Consultor II em Gestão da Inovação deve atuar no desenvolvimento e execução de serviços de consultoria voltados à inovação, apoiando empresas e instituições na identificação de demandas, criação de soluções inovadoras, prospecção de clientes e fortalecimento da competitividade organizacional. O profissional atuará com autonomia na condução de projetos, mantendo relacionamento direto com clientes e contribuindo para o aprimoramento do portfólio de soluções do IEL na área de inovação. Principais Responsabilidades : • Prospectar e atender clientes, identificando oportunidades de negócios e projetos de consultoria em gestão da inovação. • Realizar diagnósticos organizacionais e mapeamento de demandas relacionadas à inovação, tecnologia e gestão. • Criar, estruturar e implementar soluções inovadoras, alinhadas às necessidades dos clientes e às diretrizes estratégicas do IEL. • Elaborar propostas técnicas e comerciais, planos de trabalho e orçamentos para projetos e serviços de consultoria em inovação. • Acompanhar a execução dos projetos, garantindo qualidade, cumprimento de prazos e consolidação de indicadores de desempenho. • Elaborar relatórios técnicos e alimentar sistemas operacionais com informações dos serviços prestados. • Participar da elaboração, revisão e aprimoramento do portfólio de produtos e serviços em inovação do IEL. • Atuar de forma integrada com equipes internas, parceiros e fornecedores na execução dos projetos. • Representar o IEL junto a empresas, instituições públicas e privadas, bem como em eventos técnicos, tecnológicos e de inovação. Requisitos Formação: • Ensino superior completo; • Desejável pós-graduação em áreas relacionadas à inovação, tecnologia, gestão ou correlatas. Experiência • Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência profissional, preferencialmente em projetos, consultorias ou ambientes ligados à inovação, tecnologia ou desenvolvimento organizacional. Benefícios: Assistência Médica - Saúde Bradesco Vale Refeição e/ou Alimentação - R$ 949,36 Plano de Previdência Privada Convênio com o INSS (complementação de auxílio-doença) Auxílio Creche Vitalmed Seguro de Acidentes Pessoais Vale Transporte (1%) Tratamento odontológico / SESI Convênio com Óticas, Livrarias e Farmácias (NUTRICASH) Empréstimo para compra de uniforme escolar Acesso a Clubes e Colônia de férias a preço subsidiado Desconto de 50% no Teatro SESI (+ acompanhante) Cesta de Natal

title: Emerging market trader - latam (brl, mxn, ars)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Emerging market trader - latam (brl, mxn, ars) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in LATAM currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties. Key Responsibilities: FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on LATAM markets. Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions. Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets. Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant. Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization. Monitor risk limits, Pn L, and exposure across currency books. Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including: Automated hedging engines Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring. Market Development Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows. Requirements 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African currencies, such as: LATAM (BRL, MXN, ARS) Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades. Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution. Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments. Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

description:

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in LATAM currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties. Key Responsibilities: FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on LATAM markets. Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions. Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets. Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant. Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization. Monitor risk limits, Pn L, and exposure across currency books. Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including: Automated hedging engines Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring. Market Development Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows. Requirements 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African currencies, such as: LATAM (BRL, MXN, ARS) Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades. Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution. Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments. Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

title: Ingeniero de nube
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ingeniero de nube em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Top Skills' Details 1.) 5 years of experience with software engineering and in designing and building cloud native integrations. 2.) 4 years of AWS development experience (specifically with serverless and event driven architectures). 75% of the role will be focused on Development (mostly new development). 3.) 2+ years of Architecture/Design experience. This consultant must understand high level AWS best practices for code development, security standards, how to best scale & conducting code reviews for the team. This Sr Consultant will be working directly with the business to gather requirements and work with the team to ensure best development practices for delivery. 3.) 5+ years with full stack engineering background (Java Script / Type Script preferred). 4.) Hands on experience integrating with Net Suite (Suite Talk, Suite Script) and Salesforce APIs. Job Description: Our Client is the nation's leading independent service provider for critical telecommunications and renewable energy infrastructure. As our organization continues to grow through strategic acquisitions, our cloud ecosystem must remain scalable, secure, and well‐integrated. We are seeking an AWS leader who can architect and build seamless integrations across enterprise systems. The Role We are looking for a Senior AWS Developer (L3) with 5–7 years of experience, strong full‐stack engineering skills, and deep expertise in designing and building cloud‐native integrations. In this role, you will lead the development of APIs and data pipelines that connect AWS services with core business systems, specifically Net Suite, Salesforce, and other enterprise applications. You will own the full lifecycle of integration development—from solution architecture, security design, and data modeling to hands‐on coding and deployment automation. Key Responsibilities Enterprise System Integration Architect, build, and maintain integrations between AWS, Net Suite, Salesforce, and other enterprise systems. Design and implement RESTful APIs, event‐driven integrations, and data‐sync pipelines. Lead integration efforts during M& A system consolidation, ensuring that data, logic, and system flows unify cleanly across legacy platforms. AWS Engineering & Architecture Build serverless and microservices‐based applications using Lambda, API Gateway, S3, RDS, Event Bridge, SNS/SQS, and related AWS services. Develop secure, scalable backend solutions, including authentication, access control, observability, and resilience patterns. Full‐Stack Development Contribute to both backend and frontend engineering using modern Java Script/Type Script frameworks. Build dashboards, administrative tools, and workflow components that support business integration processes. Advanced Development & Data Workflows Design and maintain high performance data transformations between platforms (Salesforce Net Suite AWS).‐performance data transformations between platforms (Salesforce Net Suite AWS). Implement robust ETL/ELT patterns for large‐scale data migrations and cross‐platform synchronization. Perform deep‐dive field mapping, data normalization, and validation across systems. Technical Leadership & Collaboration Translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. Produce clear architectural diagrams, sequence flows, and Build‐vs‐Buy recommendations. Lead technical discussions with internal teams and stakeholders from acquired companies. Qualifications Required Technical Skills 5–7 years professional software engineering experience with increasing seniority. Expert level AWS development experience, especially with serverless and eventdriven architectures.‐level AWS development experience‐driven architectures. Strong full‐stack engineering background (Java Script / Type Script preferred). Proven track record developing REST APIs, microservices, and cloud‐native applications. Hands‐on experience integrating with Net Suite (Suite Talk, Suite Script) and Salesforce APIs. Strong data modeling skills and experience with large‐scale migration tooling. Solid understanding of CI/CD and Dev Ops tooling (Git Hub Actions, Copado, Gearset, etc.). Soft Skills Excellent English communication skills and the ability to document architectures clearly. Strong analytical and root‐cause debugging skills. Ability to collaborate with cross‐functional business and engineering teams. Preferred Skills Experience with Event Bridge, App Flow, or enterprise i Paa S tools. Background in M& A system consolidation or multi‐system enterprise architecture.

title: Desenvolvedor (a) full stack
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor (a) full stack em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Hub4 Pay é uma fintech brasileira especializada em soluções de pagamentos, incentivos e recompensas, criada para conectar empresas e pessoas por meio de tecnologia, eficiência e experiências relevantes. Atuamos em um mercado dinâmico e em constante transformação, onde inovação não é diferencial, é ponto de partida. Acreditamos que tecnologia de ponta nasce de times que combinam excelência técnica, autonomia e propósito. Por isso, construímos um ambiente onde cada pessoa tem espaço para experimentar, errar com responsabilidade, aprender rápido e gerar impacto real, tanto no produto quanto na vida de quem usa nossas soluções. Estamos buscando um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack para integrar nosso time de tecnologia e atuar no desenvolvimento de aplicações web modernas, escaláveis e de alto desempenho, com forte foco em soluções baseadas em Inteligência Artificial (IA). Nosso stack principal inclui Nest JS no back-end e React no front-end, e buscamos alguém que tenha experiência e paixão por construir produtos robustos, eficientes e inteligentes, utilizando IA para otimizar processos, criar automações e desenvolver funcionalidades inovadoras. Se você gosta de desafios, curte boas práticas de desenvolvimento, tem interesse em tecnologias de IA e quer trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo, essa vaga é para você! Principais Responsabilidades Experiência com ferramentas de IA aplicadas ao desenvolvimento, como Cursor, Replit, Lovable, Git Hub Copilot, agentes de código ou automações por prompt. Desenvolver e manter aplicações com Node.js, Nest JS, React.js e Type Script; Criar, evoluir e documentar APIs RESTful; Participar de decisões de arquitetura e desenho técnico de features; Revisar PRs, orientar boas práticas e contribuir para a evolução técnica do time; Apoiar a especialização dos demais desenvolvedores por meio de troca de conhecimento, revisão técnica e mentoria; Manter a documentação técnica atualizada; Atuar diretamente com o time de suporte na investigação e resolução de bugs, discoveries e melhorias; Trabalhar com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais; Implementar testes unitários e de integração; Atuar com sistemas de caching, microsserviços, workers e processamento assíncrono; Trabalhar com integrações externas, incluindo APIs financeiras, nota fiscal, clientes e usuários; Apoiar práticas de CI/CD em ambientes Azure utilizando Git Hub Actions; Trabalhar em processos ágeis com Scrum, utilizando ferramentas como Jira para acompanhamento de demandas, bugs e discoveries; Aplicar boas práticas de segurança, arquitetura, SOLID e qualidade de código; Utilizar ferramentas de IA no dia a dia, como prompts, agentes, Cursor, Copilot ou similares. Requisitos da Posição Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência profissional no mercado de tecnologia; Mínimo de 2 anos de experiência com ferramentas de IA aplicadas ao desenvolvimento, como Cursor, Replit, Lovable, Git Hub Copilot, agentes de código ou automações por prompt; Graduação em Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas, com diploma de curso superior de 4 anos ou mais na área de tecnologia; Experiência sólida com Node.js, Nest JS, React.js e Type Script; Experiência com desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful; Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais; Experiência com testes unitários e de integração; Conhecimento em caching, microsserviços, workers e processamento assíncrono; Experiência com Azure, CI/CD e Git Hub Actions; Experiência com ferramentas como Postman ou similares; Conhecimento em Scrum, ritos ágeis e ferramentas de gestão como Jira; Conhecimento em SOLID, arquitetura de software e boas práticas de desenvolvimento; Boa comunicação, autonomia técnica e capacidade de colaborar com diferentes áreas. Diferenciais Experiência prévia com sistemas financeiros, preferencialmente por pelo menos 1 a 2 anos; Experiência com APIs de integração financeira; Experiência com nota fiscal; Experiência com sistemas de gerenciamento de clientes e usuários; Experiência com React Native para i OS e Android; Conhecimento em LGPD; Experiência com Azure Functions; O que oferecemos Trabalho remoto; VR; Plano de saúde sem coparticipação; Ambiente colaborativo; Plano de carreira; Participação em projetos com impacto real no negócio. Por que se juntar à Hub4 Pay Aqui você vai encontrar um time pequeno, técnico e altamente colaborativo, onde sua voz tem peso desde o primeiro dia. Trabalhamos com problemas reais, prazos reais e impacto mensurável, mas com a leveza de quem sabe que sustentabilidade do negócio também depende do bem-estar das pessoas. Valorizamos quem tem inquietação saudável, gosta de fazer perguntas difíceis, defende seu ponto de vista com argumentos e está sempre disposto a aprender. Se você se reconhece nisso e quer construir, junto com a gente, a próxima geração de soluções financeiras inteligentes, queremos te conhecer.

title: Ingeniero de nube
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ingeniero de nube em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Top Skills' Details 1.) 5 years of experience with software engineering and in designing and building cloud native integrations. 2.) 4 years of AWS development experience (specifically with serverless and event driven architectures). 75% of the role will be focused on Development (mostly new development). 3.) 2+ years of Architecture/Design experience. This consultant must understand high level AWS best practices for code development, security standards, how to best scale & conducting code reviews for the team. This Sr Consultant will be working directly with the business to gather requirements and work with the team to ensure best development practices for delivery. 3.) 5+ years with full stack engineering background (Java Script / Type Script preferred). 4.) Hands on experience integrating with Net Suite (Suite Talk, Suite Script) and Salesforce APIs. Job Description: Our Client is the nation's leading independent service provider for critical telecommunications and renewable energy infrastructure. As our organization continues to grow through strategic acquisitions, our cloud ecosystem must remain scalable, secure, and well‐integrated. We are seeking an AWS leader who can architect and build seamless integrations across enterprise systems. The Role We are looking for a Senior AWS Developer (L3) with 5–7 years of experience, strong full‐stack engineering skills, and deep expertise in designing and building cloud‐native integrations. In this role, you will lead the development of APIs and data pipelines that connect AWS services with core business systems, specifically Net Suite, Salesforce, and other enterprise applications. You will own the full lifecycle of integration development—from solution architecture, security design, and data modeling to hands‐on coding and deployment automation. Key Responsibilities Enterprise System Integration Architect, build, and maintain integrations between AWS, Net Suite, Salesforce, and other enterprise systems. Design and implement RESTful APIs, event‐driven integrations, and data‐sync pipelines. Lead integration efforts during M& A system consolidation, ensuring that data, logic, and system flows unify cleanly across legacy platforms. AWS Engineering & Architecture Build serverless and microservices‐based applications using Lambda, API Gateway, S3, RDS, Event Bridge, SNS/SQS, and related AWS services. Develop secure, scalable backend solutions, including authentication, access control, observability, and resilience patterns. Full‐Stack Development Contribute to both backend and frontend engineering using modern Java Script/Type Script frameworks. Build dashboards, administrative tools, and workflow components that support business integration processes. Advanced Development & Data Workflows Design and maintain high performance data transformations between platforms (Salesforce Net Suite AWS).‐performance data transformations between platforms (Salesforce Net Suite AWS). Implement robust ETL/ELT patterns for large‐scale data migrations and cross‐platform synchronization. Perform deep‐dive field mapping, data normalization, and validation across systems. Technical Leadership & Collaboration Translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. Produce clear architectural diagrams, sequence flows, and Build‐vs‐Buy recommendations. Lead technical discussions with internal teams and stakeholders from acquired companies. Qualifications Required Technical Skills 5–7 years professional software engineering experience with increasing seniority. Expert level AWS development experience, especially with serverless and eventdriven architectures.‐level AWS development experience‐driven architectures. Strong full‐stack engineering background (Java Script / Type Script preferred). Proven track record developing REST APIs, microservices, and cloud‐native applications. Hands‐on experience integrating with Net Suite (Suite Talk, Suite Script) and Salesforce APIs. Strong data modeling skills and experience with large‐scale migration tooling. Solid understanding of CI/CD and Dev Ops tooling (Git Hub Actions, Copado, Gearset, etc.). Soft Skills Excellent English communication skills and the ability to document architectures clearly. Strong analytical and root‐cause debugging skills. Ability to collaborate with cross‐functional business and engineering teams. Preferred Skills Experience with Event Bridge, App Flow, or enterprise i Paa S tools. Background in M& A system consolidation or multi‐system enterprise architecture.

title: Lp partnership manager (latam)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lp partnership manager (latam) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. We are looking for anLP Partnership Manager (LATAM)to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across Latin America. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners throughout the region, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.The ideal candidate is deeply embedded within the LATAM financial ecosystem, with a strong network of regional liquidity providers, banks, payment processors, OTC desks, and institutional partners. They should possess a strong understanding of local market structures, FX and payment flows, regulatory nuances, and banking infrastructure across key LATAM corridors.Key Responsibilities:
Business Development & Partnerships
Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers across LATAM
Evaluate LP quality including pricing, depth, reliability, settlement capabilities, and regional coverage
Negotiate trading terms including spreads, fees, credit lines, settlement arrangements, and margin terms
Build strategic partnerships with local banks, payment providers, OTC desks, and institutional counterparties
Market & Network Development
Leverage an existing LATAM network to expand LP coverage across key markets including Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, and other emerging corridors
Maintain strong relationships with regional banks, payment providers, FX brokers, and liquidity partners
Stay up to date with local market dynamics, regulatory developments, FX controls, pricing trends, and competitive landscape across LATAM
Provide local market intelligence and operational insight to support regional expansion and corridor development
Execution & Collaboration
Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, execution quality, and settlement efficiency for LATAM flows
Coordinate with internal compliance, operations, treasury, and onboarding teams to ensure smooth LP integration and operational setup
Support ongoing performance monitoring, optimization, and expansion of LP relationships across the region
Assist in identifying new liquidity opportunities tied to stablecoin adoption and cross-border payment demand in LATAM
Banking & Infrastructure Setup
Facilitate the opening of local bank accounts and establishment of payment rails required for LP operations in LATAM markets
Identify suitable banking and payment partners to support local currency settlement, cross-border flows, and fiat-to-stablecoin conversion
Support infrastructure setup for regional treasury operations, local collections, and payout capabilities
Requirements
5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, liquidity management, or institutional sales
Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, digital assets, or related financial services
Deep understanding of LATAM financial markets, local banking systems, payment infrastructure, and regional liquidity dynamics
Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, OTC desks, payment processors, and institutional partners across LATAM
Proven ability to source, onboard, and manage LPs within local LATAM markets
Strong knowledge of cross-border payment corridors, local currency settlement, and regional regulatory considerations
Must have a strong and established LP network in Latin America, with particular strength in one or more major regional markets
Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is highly preferredVision & Mission
OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement, and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption.
The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners, and cross-border corridors.
OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda, and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia, and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion.

description:

JOB DESCRIPTION Somos aliados do médico durante toda a sua jornada e buscamos por pessoas que se identifiquem com nosso propósito, valores e cultura para se juntarem ao nosso time. Vamos juntos transformar a saúde com quem tem a medicina como vocação!  Esta é uma vaga aberta na frente deGraduação,  mais especificamente na Afya Centro Universitário Dom Pedro II - Salvador,  para trabalhar de formapresencial na cidade de Salvador - BA . Saiba mais em: Buscamos um(a) Assistente Comercial e Marketing com foco em Marketing Digital para atuar no suporte às estratégias da área, contribuindo diretamente para a geração de leads, fortalecimento da marca e apoio às ações de captação. A posição terá forte atuação na produção de conteúdos visuais e digitais, sendo essencial ter criatividade, agilidade e olhar estratégico para resultados. Horário: Segunda à quinta-feira 08h às 18 e sexta-feira 08h às 17h Remuneração: R$ 2.218,39 Todas as nossas oportunidades são abertas a pessoas com deficiência (Pc D) e reabilitadas do INSS. RESPONSIBILITIES AND ASSIGNMENTS COMO VOCÊ VAI TRANSFORMAR A SAÚDE NO DIA A DIA: Criar peças gráficas para campanhas e redes sociais (posts, stories, banners e materiais institucionais) Editar vídeos para plataformas digitais (Reels, Tik Tok, You Tube) Apoiar na execução de campanhas de marketing e ações de captação Produzir conteúdos visuais alinhados à identidade da marca Apoiar na cobertura de eventos (captação de fotos e vídeos) Atuar em parceria com o time comercial na criação de materiais de conversão Organizar demandas, prazos e entregas da área Acompanhar tendências digitais e sugerir melhorias nas estratégias de conteúdo REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS O QUE BUSCAMOS (mas não esperamos que uma única pessoa atenda a todos os requisitos): Ensino superior cursando ou completo em: Marketing, Publicidade e Propaganda, Design Gráfico ou áreas correlatas Conhecimento em ferramentas de criação: Canva, Pacote Adobe (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere) ou Cap Cut Noções de Redes sociais (Instagram, Tik Tok, You Tube), Produção de conteúdo digital e Marketing de conteúdo Diferenciais Experiência com campanhas de captação (educação será um diferencial) Conhecimento em tráfego pago Noções de copywriting Agilidade e senso de urgência Criatividade com foco em conversão ADDITIONAL INFORMATION ️ GENTE É O MELHOR DA GENTE, por isso, oferecemos benefícios e parcerias para o nosso time. Confira os principais abaixo:   Para o dia a dia: Vale-alimentação / refeição; Vale-transporte ‍‍‍ Família, Saúde e Bem-estar: Gympass / Wellhub, Totalpass; Conexa (plataforma online para consulta com psicólogo e nutricionista); Plano de Saúde e Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Licença parental estendida (até 6 meses para mães e 20 dias para pais);  Parceria com o SESC da sua região (programação variada nas áreas de educação, saúde, cultura, lazer e assistência);  Day Off de Aniversário (um dia de folga para tirar no dia ou durante o mês do seu aniversário).  Desenvolvimento e Aprendizado: Plataforma com diversos cursos para aprimorar seu conhecimento (UCA); Academia de idiomas (AIA);  Desconto em cursos de graduação e pós-graduação nas unidades de ensino da Afya.  SOMOS A AFYA, O MAIOR ECOSSISTEMA DE EDUCAÇÃO E SOLUÇÕES PARA PRÁTICA MÉDICA DO BRASIL. A marca Afya nasceu em 2019, mas nossa história começou muito antes. Surgimos da união entre a NRE Educacional, maior grupo de faculdades de Medicina do país, fundado em 1999, com a MEDCEL, marca de cursos preparatórios para prova de residência médica. Com o nosso crescimento acelerado, adquirimos nos últimos anos novas unidades de ensino — já são mais de 30 espalhadas pelo Brasil — e mais de 10 startups que oferecem soluções digitais para a prática médica — Afya Whitebook, Afya i Clinic, Afya Papers, Glic e Cliquefarma são algumas marcas do nosso portfólio. Acesse para conhecer mais sobre a nossa história e todas as soluções que oferecemos. A Afya é uma companhia de capital aberto desde 2019, com ações negociadas na bolsa de valores Nasdaq, nos Estados Unidos. Em 2023 disponibilizamos nossas ações também na bolsa brasileira, a B3. Saiba mais sobre esse assunto em. Nosso propósito é transformar a saúde em conjunto com quem tem a medicina como vocação. Para isso, contamos com um time de 10 mil pessoas curiosas, parceiras, comprometidas, adaptáveis e realizadoras. Gente de todos os cantos do Brasil, com diferentes sotaques, mas falando a mesma língua, unida pelo mesmo propósito. Se você se identifica com o jeito Afya de ser, vem com a gente transformar a saúde com educação e tecnologia . #Vem Ser Afya

title: Analista de treinamento operacional pl
description:

JOB DESCRIPTION A Movida é uma empresa de soluções inovadoras em mobilidade urbana e modelo de negócios com forte direcionamento para desenvolvimento socioambiental. Desde 2006 no mercado, conta hoje com a frota mais nova do Brasil e dispõe de lojas nas principais cidades e aeroportos do país. A companhia é reconhecida como uma locadora moderna, alinhada às últimas tendências tecnológicas e que investe em diversificação e renovação de frota, treinamento de funcionários e serviços exclusivos. Norteada pela devoção em servir, foi pioneira em oferecer serviços como aluguel mensal e de longo prazo para pessoa física, opções para pré-pagamento e diárias de 27 horas. Focada em tecnologia, também saiu na frente do setor ao oferecer soluções como web check-in, wi-fi no carro, chatbot nas redes sociais e tecnologia de pagamento contactless em todos os veículos. Empresa da SIMPAR, hoje faz parte da Movida Participações, criada em 2015 para administrar as operações de Aluguel de Carros, Venda de Seminovos e de Gestão de Terceirização de Frotas de veículos leves. Com mais de 6000 colaboradores apaixonados, a Movida se diferencia pelo seu "jeitão" inovador e descomplicado. Carrega em seu DNA o foco no cliente e a sua GENTE como prioridade! Todos os processos seletivos conduzidos pela MOVIDA  são afirmativos, inclusivos e não discriminatórios. RESPONSIBILITIES AND ASSIGNMENTS Responsável pela venda presencial de veículos seminovos, acompanhando o processo de pré-venda e pós-venda focado em oferecer uma experiência única ao cliente.  Acompanhamento e captação de clientes; Planejar as vendas de produtos e veículos; Pesquisar indicadores do mercado consumidor; Relacionar-se com clientes internos; Atendimento ao cliente no pré e pós-venda; Assegurar o atendimento aos objetivos e metas do sistema de gestão integrado aplicáveis à área, além de realizar as tarefas conforme definido nos controles operacionais. REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS Ensino Médio Completo; Possuir CNH válida; Vivência ou experiência na área de vendas; Conhecimento no pacote office. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION Os benefícios tradicionais que você já conhece, nós também temos. Queremos te mostrar que vamos além. Saiba mais! LIGADO EM VOCÊ:  Atendimento especializado para a nossa gente e familiares por meio de uma central 24 horas para apoio psicológico, sobre saúde, social, familiar, financeiro e/ou jurídico e tudo isso com sigilo absoluto. Licença Maternidade  e Paternidade estendidas  + Kit nascimento  para recém-mamães e recém-papais. Sabemos o quanto a educação das crianças e adolescentes é importante. Aqui na MOVIDA , damos aquela ajuda na compra do kit escolar  para os filhos da nossa gente. Nossa gente tem acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma de descontos  em viagens, cultura e entretenimento, serviços, gastronomia, educação e bem-estar. Pela Universidade MOVIDA , a nossa gente aprende e potencializa seu desenvolvimento profissional, tornando cada um(a) protagonista de sua carreira. Reconhecemos e valorizamos a nossa gente veterana  que completa anos de casa. Quem possui mais de 15 anos , ainda tem um evento mega especial. Cantinho da Mamãe:  O espaço, na Matriz no Itaim Bibi e Sede Administrativa em Mogi das Cruzes, é dedicado as mamães que retornam de licença maternidade e querem seguir com o aleitamento materno.  No local, há todos os itens para retirar e armazenar o leite, com privacidade e conforto. Totalpass: Acesso a uma ampla rede de academias e serviços de saúde mental e nutrição, promovendo hábitos saudáveis e bem-estar. Se identificou com essa vaga? Conheça as nossas vagas, inscreva-se e vamos juntos participar dessa Empresa que cresce todos os dias. SOBRE A MOVIDA Sobre Movida A Movida (MOVI3) é uma empresa de aluguel de carros que oferece soluções inovadoras em mobilidade urbana para todo tipo de necessidade. Pioneira em oferecer serviços como aluguel mensal para pessoa física, Wi-Fi no carro, pré-pagamento e Chat Bot nas redes sociais, foi a primeira locadora do país a ir além do carro, ajudando a revolucionar o setor de locação no Brasil. Antenada aos novos tempos, investe em sustentabilidade, sendo a primeira locadora de veículos no mundo, listada em bolsa, a receber a Certificação de Empresa B, fazendo parte de um seleto grupo de companhias que têm como modelo de negócios o desenvolvimento socioambiental. No Brasil, foi a primeira a ter um programa como o Carbon Free, que neutraliza as emissões de CO2 das locações dos seus clientes. Desde 2006 no mercado, a Movida foi adquirida em 2013 pela JSL, abriu capital em fevereiro de 2017 e hoje é uma das empresas da SIMPAR S. A. Com perfil inovador aliado a forte governança corporativa, atua tanto no varejo, com aluguel de carros, como no mercado corporativo, com a terceirização de frotas para empresas, além da venda de seminovos. Após diversos investimentos nos últimos quatro anos, conta com uma frota de mais de 268 mil veículos, 259 lojas de aluguel de carros e 89 pontos de venda de seminovos. FX trading systems

Skills

Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Garantir o cumprimento do plano de manutenção e dos apontamentos no sistema ERP.
Participar do planejamento semanal e validar as ordens de serviço com base na criticidade, recursos e prioridade.

Contribuir com auditorias internas e externas, garantindo o alinhamento técnico da área.
Desenvolver tecnicamente os profissionais da equipe, promovendo conhecimento e engajamento.
Apoiar o Coordenador de Manutenção nas definições estratégicas e gestão de recursos.
Realizar interface com outras áreas para alinhamento técnico e definição de prioridades.
Validar escopos de manutenção sob demanda, materiais e serviços de terceiros.

Ensino Técnico Completo em Elétrica, Eletrônica, Mecatrônica e áreas correlatas.
Desejável ensino superior cursando em Engenharia Elétrica, Eletrônica, Mecatrônica e áreas correlatas.
Experiência em Manutenção Industrial.
Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em Feira de Santana - BA.
Domínio em Interpretação e atualização de diagramas elétricos e eletrônicos.
Conhecimento em comandos elétricos e motores, em Subestações (13,8 e 69 k V) e em Ferramentas e equipamentos de medição elétrica.
Domínio Multiplicador em Manutenção elétrica e eletrônica.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor de inglês em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Oportunidade para Professor(a) de Inglês – Parceria para Autônomos (PJ/MEI) PROFESSOR AVANÇADO Estamos expandindo nosso time e buscamos professores de inglês que queiram atuar como parceiros prestadores de serviços. Se você é um profissional autônomo, possui MEI e busca flexibilidade, essa vaga é para você. Sobre a Parceria (Modelo MEI): Trata-se de uma contratação de serviço autônomo (PJ). Não é regime CLT, mas sim uma parceria direta entre profissionais formalizados. Remuneração: O repasse é calculado por aluno. Valor de Referência: R$ 160,00 mensais por aluno (baseado em aulas de 2 horas semanais). (por volta de 17.5 a 20 reais por hora dependendo do mês). Escalabilidade: Esse valor é variável. O seu ganho mensal dependerá do número de alunos que você assumir e do plano de aulas (carga horária semanal) que cada aluno escolher. O que buscamos: \"I'm looking for English teachers who understand that a conversation is better than a textbook.\" Take your time to read the content below carefully. *- Particularly looking for organized and adaptable people.* Greetings! We believe that English is a living tool, not a set of rules in a book. Our company is built on a 1-on-1 Conversational Methodology that prioritizes real-world fluency over parrot-fashioned memorization. Here's what we recommend about our *Methodology*. *Adaptive Correction:* You don't just interrupt; you adapt to the student's learning style. You master the \"Art of Correction\"—knowing exactly when to fix a mistake on the spot for immediate growth, or when to let the student finish their thought to maintain their confidence. *Pattern Recognition:* We don't just fix one-off errors. We look for the \"Patterns\" of the student's mistakes. When a pattern emerges, you will design a specific, creative class or exercise to help the student understand and break that pattern permanently. *Creative Freedom:* While our core is conversational, we value your unique voice. You are encouraged to bring your own methodologies and creative tools into the session, but if the primary focus remains on high-engagement, the students would love it, that's our suggestion. *The Selection Process: (For those who want to apply)* I value clarity and energy above all else. Because we are a conversational-first company, I do not hire based on resumes alone. *(Not Necessary but PREFERRED) To apply, you SHOULD include a 60-second video introduction with your application.* * The Goal: I want to see your communication style, your presence, and how you explain a complex idea simply. *The Format:* Don't overthink it—no professional editing required. Just show me who you are as a communicator. You may introduce yourself, or follow any format you feel comfortable with. Afterwards I will check and decide who gets a chance at an interview, applicants with an introduction video have a higher chance of getting selected. Vantagens: Autonomia na prestação dos serviços. Possibilidade de aumentar o faturamento conforme a entrada de novos alunos. Sem burocracia de vínculo empregatício.

title: Back end developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Back end developer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Exactius Exactius works with companies to solve complex digital marketing challenges and achieve ambitious growth goals. We bring executive leadership and cross-functional execution teams that can form the strategy and execute and deliver the result. Those teams are supported by a proprietary technology named Violet that supports the need for advanced analysis and real-time optimization. Exactius is an extension of the partner's internal teams with one goal: to grow faster and be more profitable. About Violet Violet is a scalable infrastructure to track and visualize data sources for data-driven, sophisticated decision-making. Violet includes a robust business intelligence capacity to support marketing executives in managing their investments to maximize their performance. Using Violet, the partner can align their GTM KPIs with their financial goals & strategy and create the right balance between brand and performance investments. About the Role We are looking for a strong Backend Developer to join our team and take ownership of the services that power our proprietary analytics, optimization, and data products. You will design, build, and maintain the backend systems that our analysts, data scientists, and clients rely on every day. This is a high-ownership role with real impact from day one. You will work independently on meaningful problems — from designing APIs and microservices to shipping new product capabilities — while collaborating closely with data engineers, data scientists, and product leads. What You'll Do Design, build, and maintain production backend services, APIs, and microservices that power our data and marketing products. Own features end-to-end — from technical design through deployment, monitoring, and iteration. Partner with data engineers and data scientists to productize analytical and AI/LLM-based workflows. Write clean, well-tested Python code and contribute to engineering best practices across the team. Ensure reliability, performance, and scalability of our backend systems. Work closely with product and analytics stakeholders to translate business needs into robust technical solutions. Requirements Must-Haves Strong backend engineering experience — proven track record building and running production services, APIs, and microservices. GCP or other cloud infrastructure experience. Strong Python — you are fluent in Python and comfortable using it for non-trivial backend systems. Senior or strong mid-level — you have taken production ownership of services and features in previous roles. Independent operator — comfortable working with minimal hand-holding, making pragmatic technical decisions, and driving work forward. Availability — able to start quickly. Nice-to-Haves (Bonus, Not a Filter) Experience with AI workflows and LLM-based implementations. Background in data science or experience working on data products. Data pipeline experience. Benefits & Perks Opportunity to have a real impact in a high-growth international brand. Work remote from anywhere in the world. Control your time — flexible hours. Responsibility from day one, with room for professional and personal growth. Great company culture, working alongside rockstar professionals from various industries and backgrounds. We care about you and your career path.

O que buscamos: \"I'm looking for English teachers who understand that a conversation is better than a textbook.\" Take your time to read the content below carefully. *- Particularly looking for organized and adaptable people.* Greetings! We believe that English is a living tool, not a set of rules in a book. Our company is built on a 1-on-1 Conversational Methodology that prioritizes real-world fluency over parrot-fashioned memorization. Here's what we recommend about our *Methodology*. *Adaptive Correction:* You don't just interrupt; you adapt to the student's learning style. You master the \"Art of Correction\"—knowing exactly when to fix a mistake on the spot for immediate growth, or when to let the student finish their thought to maintain their confidence. *Pattern Recognition:* We don't just fix one-off errors. We look for the \"Patterns\" of the student's mistakes. When a pattern emerges, you will design a specific, creative class or exercise to help the student understand and break that pattern permanently. *Creative Freedom:* While our core is conversational, we value your unique voice. You are encouraged to bring your own methodologies and creative tools into the session, but if the primary focus remains on high-engagement, the students would love it, that's our suggestion. *The Selection Process: (For those who want to apply)* I value clarity and energy above all else. Because we are a conversational-first company, I do not hire based on resumes alone. *(Not Necessary but PREFERRED) To apply, you SHOULD include a 60-second video introduction with your application.* * The Goal: I want to see your communication style, your presence, and how you explain a complex idea simply. *The Format:* Don't overthink it—no professional editing required. Just show me who you are as a communicator. You may introduce yourself, or follow any format you feel comfortable with. Afterwards I will check and decide who gets a chance at an interview, applicants with an introduction video have a higher chance of getting selected. Vantagens: Autonomia na prestação dos serviços. Possibilidade de aumentar o faturamento conforme a entrada de novos alunos. Sem burocracia de vínculo empregatício.

title: Back end developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Back end developer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Exactius Exactius works with companies to solve complex digital marketing challenges and achieve ambitious growth goals. We bring executive leadership and cross-functional execution teams that can form the strategy and execute and deliver the result. Those teams are supported by a proprietary technology named Violet that supports the need for advanced analysis and real-time optimization. Exactius is an extension of the partner's internal teams with one goal: to grow faster and be more profitable. About Violet Violet is a scalable infrastructure to track and visualize data sources for data-driven, sophisticated decision-making. Violet includes a robust business intelligence capacity to support marketing executives in managing their investments to maximize their performance. Using Violet, the partner can align their GTM KPIs with their financial goals & strategy and create the right balance between brand and performance investments. About the Role We are looking for a strong Backend Developer to join our team and take ownership of the services that power our proprietary analytics, optimization, and data products. You will design, build, and maintain the backend systems that our analysts, data scientists, and clients rely on every day. This is a high-ownership role with real impact from day one. You will work independently on meaningful problems — from designing APIs and microservices to shipping new product capabilities — while collaborating closely with data engineers, data scientists, and product leads. What You'll Do Design, build, and maintain production backend services, APIs, and microservices that power our data and marketing products. Own features end-to-end — from technical design through deployment, monitoring, and iteration. Partner with data engineers and data scientists to productize analytical and AI/LLM-based workflows. Write clean, well-tested Python code and contribute to engineering best practices across the team. Ensure reliability, performance, and scalability of our backend systems. Work closely with product and analytics stakeholders to translate business needs into robust technical solutions. Requirements Must-Haves Strong backend engineering experience — proven track record building and running production services, APIs, and microservices. GCP or other cloud infrastructure experience. Strong Python — you are fluent in Python and comfortable using it for non-trivial backend systems. Senior or strong mid-level — you have taken production ownership of services and features in previous roles. Independent operator — comfortable working with minimal hand-holding, making pragmatic technical decisions, and driving work forward. Availability — able to start quickly. Nice-to-Haves (Bonus, Not a Filter) Experience with AI workflows and LLM-based implementations. Background in data science or experience working on data products. Data pipeline experience. Benefits & Perks Opportunity to have a real impact in a high-growth international brand. Work remote from anywhere in the world. Control your time — flexible hours. Responsibility from day one, with room for professional and personal growth. Great company culture, working alongside rockstar professionals from various industries and backgrounds. We care about you and your career path.

Experience working at:
Global banks
EM FX trading firms

Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades.
Technical Expertise
Deep understanding of:

Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
FX trading systems

Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

title: Sales Enablement Specialist, Digital Course & Access Programs
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sales Enablement Specialist, Digital Course & Access Programs em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of science video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role

JoVE is seeking a Sales Enablement Specialist - Digital Course Materials & Access Programs to support the operational delivery and adoption of JoVE’s digital science video platform across higher education institutions.

This role sits within the Sales Enablement team and focuses on managing course material adoptions, supporting bookstore affordability programs such as Inclusive Access and Equitable Access, and ensuring the reliable delivery of JoVE content through Learning Management Systems (LMS).

While JoVE’s Customer Success team works directly with faculty on course-level implementation, this role focuses on operational workflows, adoption tracking, data analysis, and identifying trends or systemic issues affecting digital course material delivery.

The ideal candidate combines strong operational and analytical skills with meaningful experience working with LMS platforms and LTI-based integrations used in higher education courseware delivery.


Responsibilities:

  • Manage course material adoptions and digital product fulfillment across higher education accounts.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Month 1: Master the platform architecture and contribute to technical design discussions
  • Month 3: Independently deliver complex features with meaningful impact on patient outcomes

title: Full Stack Engineer (Python/React/AI tools)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer (Python/React/AI tools) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our engineering team builds agentic solutions that data and research teams utilize to transform petabytes of raw data into strategic intelligence. Our resulting product delivers accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers — ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies — depend on to drive high-stakes decisions.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture — recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years — emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting — it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high — always with purpose and intention

About The Role

We’re looking for a seasoned, high-output engineer who can develop our rapidly growing agent platform for our Revenue organization. This individual will sit on our Infrastructure team that builds AI-native solutions used by the entire company to find, convert, and better enable customers with the products we launch. The ideal candidate possesses 3+ years of architecting and developing full-stack applications, proficient data analytics skills, strong interest in agentic workflows, and 5+ years working on applications or codebases built with Python, Databricks, React/JavaScript/TypeScript, and AWS.

You’ll be responsible for production-grade systems that our customers and internal teams depend on daily. That means being responsive, reliable, and an excellent communicator — both when things are going well and especially when they’re not.

The ideal candidate treats AI coding tools as core infrastructure for how they work — not a novelty. You’ve shipped full-stack applications, you’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, and you are customer-obsessed in your approach to improving software.

As a Senior Software Engineer, You Will

  • Own features and systems end-to-end across multiple product surfaces — architecture, implementation, deployment, and iteration
  • Architect and deliver solutions for our Revenue, Revenue Operations, and Business Development teams – including data tools, applications, and agentic orchestrators
  • Serve as a subject matter expert across the whole stack, and report directly to the Chief Architect, who will provide hands-on mentorship in cutting‑edge AI-native development, big data analytics, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Collaborate closely with the Revenue organization, discovering opportunities, projects, and areas to revamp critical business processes with AI
  • Drive initiatives across teams — you’re not waiting for a PM to write a spec; you’re in the room shaping what gets built and why
  • Leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex to improve personal productivity, ship trustworthy solutions faster through harness engineering, code quality, and documentation.
  • Produce clear documentation: create playbooks, docs, and training materials to institutionalize best practices.

You Are Likely To Succeed If

  • You have 5+ years of hands-on software development experience with a proven track record of shipping customer-facing applications — and the impact to show for it
  • You are stack-flexible: comfortable working across Python, TypeScript/React, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Databricks). You learn new tools fast and don’t let unfamiliar tech slow you down
  • You have an AI-accelerated workflow — you actively use AI coding tools to ship faster, not as an experiment, but as how you work every day
  • You thrive in ambiguity — you can take a vague business problem, break it down, and deliver a working solution without heavy-handed direction
  • You are a strong communicator who can work directly with non-technical stakeholders, translate between business needs and engineering tradeoffs, and drive alignment
  • You are responsive and reliable — you take ownership of production systems and communicate proactively, especially under pressure
  • You have a bias toward action and ownership — you see a problem, you fix it; you see an opportunity, you ship it
  • You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)

What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Professor de Espanhol
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor de Espanhol em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather and analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable Salesforce solutions.

Qualifications:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 7 to 10 years of hands-on experience as a Salesforce Systems Analyst or Administrator with a focus on Sales Cloud .
  • Salesforce certifications such as Salesforce Certified Administrator , Salesforce Certified Sales Cloud Consultant , or equivalent are highly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience in application administration, configuration, and customization of Salesforce environments.

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Information Technology Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview


Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration.


Key Responsibilities


Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation)

  • Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes.
  • Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes.
  • Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations.
  • Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools.

Automation, Integration & AI Implementation

  • Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript).
  • Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks.
  • Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software.

IT Administration & Security

  • Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365).
  • Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access.
  • Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security.
  • Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.


Required Qualifications & Skills


Technical Experience:

  • 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration.
  • Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures.
  • High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting.
  • Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows.
  • Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.


Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:

  • Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity.
  • Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms.
  • Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions.


Benefits & Compensation

  • Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

Founded in 2018, BingX is a leading cryptocurrency exchange, serving over 20 million users worldwide. BingX offers diversified products and services, including spot, derivatives, copy trading, and asset management – all designed for the evolving needs of users, from beginners to professionals.


BingX is committed to providing a trustworthy platform that empowers users with innovative tools and features to elevate their trading proficiency.


Our current vacancy | Full-time | Long-term | REMOTE

The Senior Compliance Manager will join the global legal and compliance team, with a primary focus on Brazil and the broader Latin American regulatory landscape. This role requires a proactive self-starter with a strong interest in financial innovation and digital assets, who thrives in a cross-functional, fast-paced environment. The successful candidate will lead regulatory and licensing efforts related to crypto operations in Brazil while supporting regional expansion initiatives.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead regulatory compliance strategy and licensing/registration efforts for crypto-related activities in Brazil, including engagement with the Central Bank of Brazil (BCB), Comissão de Valores Mobiliários (CVM), and other relevant authorities
  • Monitor and interpret developments in Brazil’s crypto regulatory framework (e.g., Law No. 14,478/2022 and related regulations), and assess their impact on business operations
  • Act as the primary project manager for licensing and regulatory initiatives, coordinating with external counsel, consultants, and internal stakeholders
  • Provide clear, practical, and solution-oriented compliance guidance to product, operations, and business teams to enable compliant product launches and expansion
  • Deliver internal training programs and update training materials to reflect regulatory changes and best practices

Knowledge:

  • Strong understanding of Brazil’s crypto and financial regulatory environment, including digital asset frameworks and payment systems (e.g., PIX)
  • Familiarity with AML/CFT regulations, data protection (LGPD), and financial consumer protection laws in Brazil
  • Experience in the crypto, fintech, or payments industry is highly preferred
  • Understanding of global regulatory trends in digital assets is a plus


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Law, Finance, Business, or a related field
  • 7 to 9 years of regulatory compliance experience, with at least 3 years focused on crypto, fintech, payments, or financial services in Brazil
  • Proven experience handling regulatory licensing, compliance frameworks, and regulator engagement in Brazil
  • Ability to advise on regulatory implications for product design, modification, and market expansion
  • Strong ability to navigate a dynamic and evolving regulatory landscape with ambiguity
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills and ability to work cross-functionally with senior management
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to remain composed under pressure
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Portuguese (Mandarin is a plus but not required)
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively and deliver practical, scalable compliance solutions
  • Proficiency in MS Office applications


Working at BingX

  • Great career development in a fast-growing company
  • Be part of the future of finance technology and achieve meaningful goals
  • Competitive market salary and fully remote/work-from-home flexibility
  • Flexibility to observe your local holiday calendar, alongside additional benefit
